verdict.rationale: The only self-hosting Cursor documents is Self-Hosted Machines, which moves Cloud Agent tool execution (file edits, terminal commands, computer-use tools, local MCP servers) to a worker you manage. The docs state plainly that 'Cursor runs the agent loop, inference, and planning,' so the core product stays Cursor-hosted. Bringing your own API keys only redirects chat-model calls to other providers; it does not self-host anything. Missing for 10: self-hosting of the agent loop, inference, planning and backend services; an on-prem or air-gapped deployment of the core product; independent corroboration of any self-hosted setup.
